ios.desc:
Every call counts.

Linca is an AI receptionist for business owners and professionals. It handles the calls you can't take: it finds out who is calling and what they need, answers by your instructions and sends you a summary.

You stay with the client in front of you and call back when it suits you.

An overview of every call
• A summary right after each call: who called, what they need and what Linca said. In the app and by email.
• Urgent calls first. Linca marks the calls that need attention today and sends you a priority notification.
• The details you need. Write in plain language what you want to know, and Linca asks the caller.

Calls handled by your rules
• Scenarios for meetings, evenings and holidays. Turn them on by hand, by working hours or by calendar.
• Answers based on your website. Linca knows your current prices, services and opening hours.
• Spam doesn't disturb you. Linca checks each number against 400,000+ known spam numbers. Blocked calls don't count towards your plan.

A voice that represents you
• A greeting in your company's name.
• 6 natural voices, in the tone that fits your services.
• Your contacts greeted by name.
• 90+ languages. Linca switches even mid-call.

Set up in 2 minutes
• Set up call forwarding right in the app.
• Business and personal number in one account, for example on a dual SIM.

Who Linca is for
Real estate agents, lawyers, clinics, consultants and service businesses. Anyone who can't be on the phone while they work.

Plans
You pay for handled calls, not minutes. A 1-minute call and a 10-minute call each count as one.
• Receptionist, CZK 290 a month: 80 handled calls.
• Nonstop, CZK 490 a month: unlimited handled calls for one business owner, a text message with a link for the caller, and your own voice.
Yearly billing: Receptionist CZK 2,790, Nonstop CZK 4,700.
Your first 5 handled calls are free, with no time limit.

50,000+ calls handled.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Indie Alternative to iOS 26 Call Screening

quotes.text:
Apple released iOS 26 today with built-in call screening. It works, but it feels sterile: “State the reason for your call and I’ll see if they’re available.”

I started building Ghosty as an indie alternative that makes voicemail fun and personal:

Customizable voices (your voicemail doesn’t need to sound robotic).

31+ languages (vs Apple’s limited rollout).

Personal greetings + AI instructions (e.g. delivery info, meeting availability).

Integrations: email + webhook.

Soon: Zapier/Make integrations + outbound calls.

Would love feedback: how would you personalise your voicemail?

It’s live on the App Store today.
